{{Short description|Rabbi and mathematician}}
'''Abraham Joseph ben Simon Wolf Menz''' ({{Langx|yi|אברהם יוסף בן שמעון וואָלף מענץ}}) was an eighteenth century [[rabbi]] and [[mathematician]] at [[Frankfurt]].{{r|fuenn}}

He wrote an elementary textbook on mathematics entitled ''Reshit Limmudim'',{{r|steinschneider}} in three parts: ''Kelale handasah'', the general rules of [[algebra]]; ''Yesodot ha-gematriot'', the elements of [[geometry]]; and ''Yesod ha-tekunah'', on [[astronomy]].{{r|furst}}{{r|zeitlin}} Only the first part was published (Berlin, 1775).{{r|JE}}
